<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no">
<title>Spaciel V19 — Animated Spectral Sunglint</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#101517;color:#edf2f3;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,sans-serif}
#gl{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
.panel{position:fixed;z-index:5;background:rgba(16,21,23,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#info{left:10px;top:10px;padding:11px 13px;max-width:min(650px,calc(100vw - 46px))}
#info b{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em}#info .sub{font-size:12px;color:#bdc8cb;line-height:1.4;margin-top:5px}#status{font-size:11px;color:#8fd8a6;margin-top:6px}#err{font-size:11px;color:#ff9d96;white-space:pre-wrap}
#ctrl{right:10px;bottom:10px;width:min(460px,calc(100vw - 44px));padding:10px 12px}
.modes,.buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;margin-top:7px}
button{padding:9px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:9px;background:#1c262a;color:#eef}
button.on{background:#34484e}.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:94px 1fr 50px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:6px 0;font-size:12px}
input[type=range]{width:100%}.checks{display:flex;gap:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;margin-top:7px}
@media(max-width:720px){#info{left:8px;top:8px;padding:9px 11px}#ctrl{left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px;width:auto}.row{grid-template-columns:78px 1fr 45px}}
#ctrl{max-height:72vh;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
#info{max-width:min(480px,calc(100vw - 22px))}
#ctrl button,#ctrl select{cursor:pointer}
#ctrl select{background:#182329;color:#e6f2f6;border:1px solid #53646c;border-radius:6px;padding:7px;width:100%;font-size:12px}
#ctrl .grouphead{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#86bdc9;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #3a464e;padding-top:9px}
#ctrl .row{grid-template-columns:94px 1fr 51px}
#ctrl .row.full{grid-template-columns:94px 1fr}
#fold{display:none}
#help{position:fixed;z-index:4;bottom:10px;left:10px;max-width:300px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px;color:#c0cdd1;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:720px){#info{max-width:calc(100vw - 18px)}#info .sub{display:none}#ctrl{max-height:68vh;left:8px;right:8px;bottom:8px}#fold{display:block;width:100%;margin-bottom:5px}#ctrl.folded #ctrlBody{display:none}#ctrl.folded{max-height:none}#help{bottom:10px;max-width:45%;font-size:10px;padding:6px}}
</style>
<style id="spaciel-icons-css">
#info,#ctrl,#help{display:none!important}
#poiCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
#spacielTop{position:fixed;z-index:6;top:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top));left:14px;right:14px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;pointer-events:none}
.brand{pointer-events:auto;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(9,19,26,.94),rgba(11,24,34,.70));border:1px solid rgba(165,208,227,.18);border-left:3px solid #f46b41;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0009;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 14px 11px;backdrop-filter:blur(9px)}
.brand-title{font-size:15px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:800;color:#f1f6f8;letter-spacing:.21em}.brand-sub{margin-top:5px;color:#9cbcc9;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase}.brand-note{font-size:10px;margin-top:6px;color:#77929e}
#north{pointer-events:auto;flex:0 0 auto;background:#0d1c26df;border:1px solid #627b8999;color:#d9edf4;border-radius:50%;width:45px;height:45px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #0008}
#north b{font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:#ff7052}#north small{font-size:8px;color:#cadce3;margin-top:4px}
#poiCard{position:fixed;z-index:8;left:50%;top:17%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(315px,calc(100vw - 28px));background:#07141ff0;border:1px solid #6b86955c;border-top:3px solid var(--accent,#8ce);padding:13px 15px 12px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 60px #000c;display:none;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);color:#f0f8ff}
#poiCard .micro{font-size:10px;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}#poiCard .cardtitle{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin:7px 0}#poiCard .cardnote{font-size:12px;color:#a7bdca;line-height:1.45}#poiCard .close{position:absolute;right:7px;top:7px;padding:5px 10px;background:none;color:#bfcbd4;border:0;cursor:pointer}
#filters{position:fixed;z-index:7;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));background:#07121be8;border:1px solid #4c65727a;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 46px #000b;padding:10px 11px 9px;width:min(560px,calc(100vw - 28px));box-sizing:border-box;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
#filterTitle{color:#91a9b5;font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.17em;margin:0 4px 7px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;text-transform:uppercase}#filterTitle .active-label{color:#e7f6fb}
#showAll56{padding:2px 6px;background:#233844;color:#dcecf3;border:1px solid #548396;border-radius:5px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;cursor:pointer}#showAll56[aria-pressed="false"]{background:#0e202a;color:#8cabb8;border-color:#36515f}#filterButtons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.filter{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--hue) 35%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--hue) 10%,#08131b);border-radius:8px;aspect-ratio:1.13;min-width:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:5px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s ease-out;position:relative}.filter img{width:80%;height:80%;max-width:38px;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--hue) 60%,transparent))}.filter.active{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--hue) 22%,#06121b);border-color:var(--hue);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--hue) inset,0 0 21px color-mix(in srgb,var(--hue) 30%,transparent)}.filter.dim{opacity:.30}.filter:active{transform:scale(.93)}
#hint{margin:8px 4px 0;color:#8ca4af;min-height:15px;font-size:10px;text-align:center}#testNote{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:116px;pointer-events:none;z-index:5;font-size:10px;color:#9cbbc9;background:#07131bce;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;max-width:320px}
@media(max-width:620px){.brand{padding:8px 11px}.brand-title{font-size:13px}.brand-note{display:none}.brand-sub{font-size:9px}#testNote{bottom:112px;left:13px;font-size:9px;max-width:220px}#filters{padding:9px 9px 8px}.filter{border-radius:7px}#hint{font-size:9px}}
@media(max-height:550px){.brand-note,#testNote{display:none}#filters{bottom:5px}#poiCard{top:8px}}
</style>

<style id="ghost-ui-style">
#spacielTop{z-index:8!important}
#poiCanvas{z-index:4!important}
#ghostNav{position:fixed;z-index:8;top:86px;left:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;pointer-events:auto}
#ghostNav button{background:rgba(9,24,32,.88);color:#d5e3df;border:1px solid #526d7780;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #0008;padding:9px 11px;min-width:90px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-align:left;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
#ghostNav button.active{background:#40534bd9;color:#f3f4e8;border-color:#abc4a988}
#zoomButtons{position:fixed;z-index:8;right:13px;top:88px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
#zoomButtons button{font-size:22px;line-height:1;background:#0a1b25e8;color:#ecf2ec;width:43px;height:43px;border:1px solid #536f7b;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer}
#ghostLegend{position:fixed;z-index:5;left:14px;bottom:176px;pointer-events:none;max-width:320px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;color:#b3c4be;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #050b0c}
#ghostLegend b{color:#e0e9df;font-size:12px}
#testNote{display:none!important}
#filters{background:#0b1820dd!important;max-width:465px}
#filterTitle{letter-spacing:.1em}
#poiCard .cardnote{font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:620px){#ghostNav{top:78px;left:8px;gap:4px}#ghostNav button{font-size:9px;min-width:69px;padding:8px 7px}#zoomButtons{top:78px;right:8px}#zoomButtons button{width:37px;height:37px}#ghostLegend{left:9px;bottom:170px;max-width:240px;font-size:10px}.brand-note{display:none!important}}
</style>

<style id="study08-seven-style">
#filters{position:fixed!important;left:-9999px!important;bottom:auto!important;top:auto!important;opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#info,#ctrl,#ghostNav,#zoomButtons,#ghostLegend,#spacielTop,#north,#testNote{display:none!important}
#study08-seven-wrap{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:20;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;pointer-events:none}
#study08-seven-wrap .dock-bg{position:relative;height:94px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,17,27,0) 0%, rgba(9,19,29,.70) 46%, rgba(8,17,27,.96) 100%);pointer-events:none}
#study08-seven-wrap .bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:70px;border:0;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#D55E00 0%,#E69F00 16.6667%,#F0E442 33.3333%,#009E73 50%,#56B4E9 66.6667%,#0072B2 83.3333%,#CC79A7 100%);pointer-events:auto}
#study08-seven-wrap canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#study08-seven-wrap .regions{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
#study08-seven-wrap .zone{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:0;color:#f2f5f7;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #000b;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;padding:3px 0;font:750 10px system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#study08-seven-wrap .zone img{width:24px;height:24px;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none;filter:brightness(0) invert(1) drop-shadow(0 1px 2px #0009)}
#study08-seven-wrap .zone.active img{filter:brightness(0) invert(1) drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.35)) drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7))}
#study08-seven-wrap .zone.active{text-shadow:0 0 7px #ffffff90,0 1px 4px #000b}
#study08-seven-wrap .zone:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f5ffff;outline-offset:-3px}
@media(max-width:380px){#study08-seven-wrap .dock-bg{height:86px}#study08-seven-wrap .bar{height:62px}#study08-seven-wrap .zone img{width:20px;height:20px}#study08-seven-wrap .zone{font-size:9px;gap:5px}}
</style>


<style id="ocean-study-styles">
#oceanStudy {position:fixed;top:193px;right:12px;z-index:11;max-width:min(225px,calc(100vw - 30px));min-width:133px;background:rgba(8,21,31,.91);border:1px solid #527f8e;border-radius:9px;color:#deedf2;font:12px/1.35 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 6px 24px #0006;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#oceanStudy summary {list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 12px;letter-spacing:.09em;font:700 10px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#d6f0f4;user-select:none}
#oceanStudy summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#oceanStudy summary::before{content:'◉';color:#85d5e5;font-size:12px}
#oceanStudy summary::after{content:'▾';margin-left:auto;color:#8dadb8}
#oceanStudy[open] summary::after{content:'▴'}
#oceanStudy .oceanBody {padding:3px 12px 12px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1a}
#oceanStudy label{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#c3d7df;margin-top:11px}
#oceanStudy .check{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#oceanStudy input[type=checkbox]{accent-color:#82d2e6;width:15px;height:15px}
#oceanStudy input[type=range]{display:block;width:100%;accent-color:#82d2e6;margin:8px 0 2px}
#oceanStudy .number{float:right;font-size:10px;color:#95c9d6;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#oceanStudy .micro{color:#819ea9;margin-top:10px;font:10px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif}
@media(max-width:620px){#oceanStudy{top:168px;right:8px;max-width:180px}#oceanStudy summary{padding:9px 10px}#oceanStudy .oceanBody{padding:3px 10px 10px}}
</style>
</head><body>

<details id="oceanStudy" aria-label="Animated ocean settings">
<summary>OCEAN GLINT</summary>
<div class="oceanBody">
<label>Surface model <select id="oceanModel" style="width:100%;margin-top:7px;background:#193342;color:#e0f4f6;padding:7px;border:1px solid #4d7c8c;border-radius:5px"><option value="1" selected>Wave spectrum — new</option><option value="0">Previous cloudy version</option></select></label>
<label class="check"><input id="oceanEnabled" type="checkbox" checked> Animated sunglint</label>
<label>Surface wind <output id="oceanWindValue" class="number">6 m/s</output><input id="oceanWind" type="range" min="1" max="14" step=".5" value="6"></label>
<label>Glint brightness <output id="oceanGainValue" class="number">1.15×</output><input id="oceanGain" type="range" min="0" max="3" step=".05" value="1.15"></label>
<label>Fine surface detail <output id="oceanDetailValue" class="number">1.3×</output><input id="oceanDetail" type="range" min="0" max="2.5" step=".1" value="1.3"></label>
<label>Motion speed <output id="oceanSpeedValue" class="number">1.5×</output><input id="oceanSpeed" type="range" min=".25" max="6" step=".25" value="1.5"></label>
<label>Sun direction <output id="oceanSunValue" class="number">50%</output><input id="oceanSun" type="range" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50"></label>
<label class="check"><input id="oceanPause" type="checkbox"> Freeze water</label>
<div class="micro" id="oceanMotionReadout" aria-live="off">Ocean time: 0.0 s</div><div class="micro">44 spectral wave components · scale-filtered highlights · visible animation. Map geometry is unchanged.</div>
</div></details>
<canvas id="gl"></canvas>
<div id="info" class="panel"><b>SPACIEL · V19 · SPECTRAL SUNGLINT</b>
<div class="sub">Translucent hidden-line buildings with a high-resolution source atlas draped on V19 terrain. Registration, coastline, 6,884 footprint positions and embedded bases are preserved.</div>
<div id="status">initialising…</div><div id="atlasReadout" style="font-size:10px;color:#9ec9dc;margin-top:3px">Atlas: loading high-resolution source…</div><div id="err"></div></div>
<div id="ctrl" class="panel folded"><button id="fold" type="button">Show building controls ▴</button><div id="ctrlBody">
<div class="grouphead" style="margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0">Building display</div>
<div class="row full"><label for="styleMode">Render style</label><select id="styleMode"><option value="clean" selected>Clean hidden-line</option><option value="faint">Faint obscured lines</option><option value="xray">Full X-ray outlines</option><option value="solid">Original solid buildings</option></select></div>
<div class="row"><label>Surface wash</label><input id="wash" type="range" min="0" max="30" step="1" value="9"><output id="washO">9%</output></div>
<div class="row"><label>Edge strength</label><input id="edgeStrength" type="range" min="10" max="100" step="5" value="75"><output id="edgeO">75%</output></div>
<div class="row"><label>Detail cutoff</label><input id="lod" type="range" min="0" max="12" step=".5" value="3"><output id="lodO">3px</output></div>
<div class="checks"><label><input type="checkbox" id="cornerOn" checked> exterior corners</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="baseEdges"> base outlines</label></div>
<div class="grouphead">Building registration (V19)</div>
<div class="modes"><button id="oldBtn">Previous bases</button><button id="newBtn" class="on">Embedded bases</button><button id="diffBtn">Review exceptions</button></div>
<div class="row"><label>Map opacity</label><input id="mapOp" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="85"><output id="mapOpO">85%</output></div>
<div class="checks"><label><input id="highAtlas" type="checkbox" checked> <b>High-resolution atlas</b> (3,304 × 5,100)</label></div>
<div style="font-size:11px;color:#a9bdc5;line-height:1.4;margin:5px 0">Toggle off for the old 50 m baked sampling. The new atlas uses the original road artwork rather than enlarged pixels.</div>
<div class="row"><label>Relief</label><input id="relief" type="range" min=".25" max="4" step=".05" value="1"><output id="reliefO">1.00×</output></div>
<div class="row"><label>Buildings</label><input id="bscale" type="range" min=".25" max="2" step=".05" value="1"><output id="bscaleO">1.00×</output></div>
<div class="row"><label>Diff range</label><input id="dscale" type="range" min="1" max="250" step="5" value="30"><output id="dscaleO">30m</output></div>
<div class="checks"><label><input id="mapOn" type="checkbox" checked> map</label><label><input id="buildOn" type="checkbox" checked> buildings</label><label><input id="maskOn" type="checkbox"> old terrain foundation mask</label><label><input id="podOn" type="checkbox"> highlight review buildings</label><label title="Diagnostic: shows the source atlas colours under water again"><input id="waterArt" type="checkbox"> underwater atlas artwork (diagnostic)</label></div>
<div class="grouphead">Navigation</div>
<div class="row"><label>Focus height</label><input id="focusH" type="range" min="-30" max="600" step="5" value="180"><output id="focusHO">180m</output></div>
<div class="buttons"><button id="oblique">Oblique</button><button id="top">Top</button><button id="whole">Whole slice</button></div>
<div class="buttons"><button id="zoomIn">Zoom +</button><button id="zoomOut">Zoom −</button><button id="resetFocus">Reset centre</button></div>
</div></div>
<div id="help" class="panel">Drag to orbit · Shift/right-drag to pan · Wheel/pinch to zoom · Two-finger drag to move</div>

<canvas id="poiCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<nav id="ghostNav" aria-label="Map scale presets"><button id="levelCity" class="active" type="button">CITY</button><button id="levelDistrict" type="button">DISTRICT</button><button id="levelArea" type="button">AREA</button><button id="levelStreet" type="button">STREET</button></nav>
<div id="zoomButtons"><button id="zoomPlus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><button id="zoomMinus" type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button></div>
<div id="ghostLegend"><b id="ghostStage">Night City · overview</b><div id="ghostHelp">Zoom towards a district to watch its name develop gradually in the terrain.</div><div id="ghostMetric" style="margin-top:3px;opacity:.75;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em"></div></div>

<div id="spacielTop"><div class="brand"><div class="brand-title">SPACIEL <span style="color:#ff8451">/</span> NIGHT CITY</div><div class="brand-sub">Terrain V19 · printed geographic lettering</div><div class="brand-note">District outlines approximate · prototype location markers</div></div><button id="north" aria-label="Rotate map to north" title="North up"><b>▲ N</b><small>000°</small></button></div>
<div id="poiCard"><button class="close" id="closePOI" aria-label="Close details">✕</button><div id="detailCat" class="micro"></div><div id="detailTitle" class="cardtitle"></div><div class="cardnote">Spaciel icon demonstration. This marker is a sample, not a verified Night City location.</div></div>
<div id="testNote">Drag to pan · pinch to zoom & rotate · names printed on terrain</div>
<nav id="filters" aria-label="Spaciel colour categories"><div id="filterTitle"><span>Explore locations · select a category</span><span id="filterLabel" class="active-label">ALL 7</span><button id="showAll56" type="button" aria-label="Show or hide extra local icons" aria-pressed="true" title="Toggle extra local markers">POI ON</button></div><div id="filterButtons"></div><div id="hint">Location markers fade in closer to the city</div></nav>
<script>
'use strict';
const HIGH_RES_ATLAS_B64="";
const TV="
